topic: The telephone: from the first telephone to today's smartphone

episode.title: From the First Telephone to Your Pocket

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of an early experimental wooden telephone, with a circular speaking opening and a separate wired listening piece. shots.action: Show the simple wooden construction as the defining feature; arrange the listening piece beside the main apparatus within a compact centered silhouette.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a candlestick telephone with an upright metal speaking horn and a separate wired receiver hanging on its side hook. shots.action: Make the tall candlestick silhouette the dominant visible change; show an undialed base and neatly arranged cord.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a black rotary desk telephone with a curved combined handset resting horizontally on its cradle. shots.action: Make the low, integrated desk-phone silhouette the dominant visible change; keep the handset neatly seated.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a black push-button desk telephone with a curved handset resting horizontally on its cradle. shots.action: Preserve the previous desk-phone proportions and replace the rotary dial with a rectangular push-button keypad as the defining change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a black brick-style handheld mobile telephone standing upright, with a thick rectangular body, long antenna, blank keypad buttons, and an unlit display. Centered on the same pale blue-gray gradient background, fixed front three-quarter view, soft upper-left lightin
shots.action: Make the self-contained handheld form the dominant visible change; show the entire antenna and remove all external cords.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a compact black candy-bar mobile telephone standing upright, with a short antenna, blank physical keypad, and an unlit display. Centered on the same pale blue-gray gradient background, fixed front three-quarter view, soft upper-left lighting, vertical 9:16 composit
shots.action: Make miniaturization the defining change: substantially reduce the body and antenna while retaining the previous phone's upright keypad layout. Preserve the camera distance.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a black clamshell mobile telephone standing upright and opened to reveal an unlit upper display and blank lower keypad. shots.action: Make the hinged folding body the defining change; keep its central axis and front-facing presentation aligned with the previous phone.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a contemporary premium smartphone standing upright, with a thin dark metal frame and nearly edge-to-edge glass display showing only a luminous abstract blue gradient. Centered on the same pale blue-gray gradient background, fixed front three-quarter view, soft uppe
shots.action: Make the uninterrupted full-face touchscreen the defining change; emphasize polished glass, narrow bezels, and precise reflections for the most impressive final image.

episode.endHook: Which telephone did you use first?
